supportedEnvironments: https://know-me.tools in iOS Safari and Android (browser not stated by the operator)
Rust server crate on the pinned toolchain, one cargo target directory

scenarioMatrix.name: Omission line present when visible content was dropped
scenarioMatrix.productionEntry: Export menu in the built site app, Save or Copy as Markdown, on a chat containing a form artifact and a remote image
scenarioMatrix.oracle: The downloaded file ends with the omission line, and neither the artifact text nor the image URL appears in the file.
scenarioMatrix.negativeControl: The same run with the detection removed: the file has no omission line and the test fails.
scenarioMatrix.fixtures: A scratch Playwright profile; a seeded thread with one form artifact and one https image from another host; digest of the seed recorded in the evidence file.
scenarioMatrix.evidence: Downloaded file and its sha256, the test run output, the mutation-check output, the tsc run on the new test.

scenarioMatrix.name: No omission line for plain or hidden-only chats
scenarioMatrix.productionEntry: Export menu in the built site app on a text-only chat and on a chat with only reasoning and step blocks besides text
scenarioMatrix.oracle: The downloaded file has no omission line.
scenarioMatrix.negativeControl: A chat with a dropped form artifact must produce the line (EXP-1); if both outputs are identical the oracle does not discriminate.
scenarioMatrix.fixtures: Two seeded threads in a scratch profile; seed digests in the evidence file.
scenarioMatrix.evidence: Both downloaded files and their sha256, test output.

scenarioMatrix.name: Reset notice shown once after purge-and-reopen
scenarioMatrix.productionEntry: Built site app opened against a database that throws a 'bundle size' error on open (method from task 1.1)
scenarioMatrix.oracle: One notice is visible after load, the chat list is empty, and the app is usable.
scenarioMatrix.negativeControl: The same run with the notice removed: no notice and the test fails.
scenarioMatrix.fixtures: A scratch browser profile with the broken database from task 1.1; its construction recorded. If task 1.1 finds no honest method, this scenario is marked BLOCKED with the reason, not passed on a mock.
scenarioMatrix.evidence: Screenshot read by the agent, the test output, the mutation-check output.

scenarioMatrix.name: No notice on a normal start or on reload after a reset
scenarioMatrix.productionEntry: Built site app in a fresh profile, then reload after DB-1
scenarioMatrix.oracle: No reset notice is visible on a normal start or on the reload that follows a reset.
scenarioMatrix.negativeControl: DB-1 must show the notice in the same harness; if neither shows it the harness is not seeing notices.
scenarioMatrix.fixtures: Fresh scratch profile; the profile from DB-1.
scenarioMatrix.evidence: Screenshots read by the agent, test output.

scenarioMatrix.name: Clippy with warnings denied is clean on the server crate
scenarioMatrix.productionEntry: cargo clippy for the server crate with warnings denied, in a clean worktree of the change branch
realCollaborators: the server crate and its dependencies
scenarioMatrix.oracle: Exit code 0 and no errors reported.
scenarioMatrix.negativeControl: The same command on clean origin/main before the fix reports the errors recorded in task 1.1.
scenarioMatrix.fixtures: Clean worktree off origin/main at 7eb995d for the baseline; the change branch for the fix.
scenarioMatrix.evidence: Both command outputs, exit codes, commit hashes.

scenarioMatrix.name: Header test asserts the Content-Security-Policy the server sends
scenarioMatrix.productionEntry: The server test suite, including server/tests/meter_and_headers.rs, in a clean worktree of the change branch
realCollaborators: the real server router in the test
the live response header read with curl -sI for comparison
scenarioMatrix.oracle: The suite passes, and the expected header in the test equals the header the server code sends.
scenarioMatrix.negativeControl: Changing the server header by one directive makes the test fail.
scenarioMatrix.fixtures: Clean worktree of the change branch; the live header captured read-only at the time of task 1.2.
scenarioMatrix.evidence: Test output, the live header text, the negative-control output.

functionalScope: Export ends with one omission line when a visible block was dropped
One reset notice, once, after a purge-and-reopen succeeds
Server clippy clean with warnings denied; header test asserts the header the server sends
Probe edits committed or discarded; stale worktrees listed with the operator's removal command

resilienceScope.policy: Adopted requirements never defer via budget overflow (exhaustion means checkpoint and BLOCKED). Only never-adopted optional items may defer.
deferredOptional: Smaller export review items (console.warn on tab switch, aria-describedby, ')' escaping, same-origin media L4)
Export description taking an abandoned first message
Monthly token ceiling change (decision D-001: no change)

exclusions: Any change to the PGlite purge-and-reopen recovery itself
Exporting or copying chats before a wipe
Changing the kill switch, the ConfigMap site-chat-kill-switch or SITE_CHAT_KILL_SWITCH_EXPECTED
Changing the production Content-Security-Policy header without the operator's agreement
requiredSafetyChecks: Export zero-network-request proof and leak test stay green, each with a mutation check
No identifier, thread id, token or URL from a dropped block appears in the omission line
A CSP header found weaker than intended stops the work and is reported to the operator
Single-writer cargo discipline: one cargo invocation at a time in one target directory
New visitor strings carry a content-officer pre-review and a review record before the PR is opened

budgets.exhaustion: Checkpoint and mark BLOCKED; never skip or downgrade a required safety check.

evidenceInvalidation: Evidence is keyed to the commit and fixture digest it ran against. A later commit to files a scenario touches invalidates that scenario's evidence only; other scenarios keep theirs; history is preserved; no blanket re-review.

workerRoutes.agent: Claude Code native subagents (km-frontend-engineer, km-rust-engineer, km-chief-content-officer read-only)
workerRoutes.billing: native session; no external billing route
workerRoutes.subagents: Native km-* subagents only; no external worker; adversarial review skipped on the operator's standing instruction.

commands: kubectl --context know-me -n knowme get deploy knowme-web -o jsonpath='{.spec.template.spec.containers[*].image}'
boundaryPacket.expectedEffects: Read-only. The live Content-Security-Policy equals the one the header test asserts; the deployed digest differs from the #125 image and matches the last merged change; reconcile reports clean.
boundaryPacket.requiredApprovals: None for the reads. The operator merges each PR; merges deploy and are not run by the agent.
boundaryPacket.receipts: Output of the three commands in evidence/<date>/boundary-packet.md.
boundaryPacket.stopConditions: A CSP header weaker than intended; an export that carries an identifier; reconcile reporting drift.
